name: Product Selection
summary:
*   Role: Product Manager at HotWax Commerce.
*   Audience: Enthusiastic Retailer.
*   Goal: Summarize a cluster of updates into a cohesive release note entry.
*   Input: A JSON object describing a PR: "Fixed: Fetched only variant products to add items to the transfer order." The context is "Filtering product searches during manual inventory transfer setups to retrieve only product variants."

    *   For new features/enhancements: Problem, Solution, Impact.
    *   For standalone bug fixes: "Fixed a bug if [Condition], [Symptom]."
    *   Style: Simple, active voice, granular but concise (3-4 sentences for features, 1 sentence for bugs).
    *   Tone: Professional, utility-focused.
    *   Constraint: NO "enhanced", "streamlined", "seamless", "robust".
    *   Constraint: NO exclamation points.
    *   Constraint: NO "fixed", "issue", "bug" for *new features* (synthesize as polished experience).
    *   Constraint: For *true bug fixes*, start with "Fixed a bug...".
    *   Constraint: Only output the summary text.

    *   The PR title says "Fixed: Fetched only variant products...".
    *   The description says "Filtering product searches during manual inventory transfer setups to retrieve only product variants."
